[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Cameron Stow (@cameronstow); megjelent: 2026-11-27T21:06:35+00:00; link: https://x.com/cameronstow/status/2126422458232107223; média: videó, 64 másodperc]
I’ve been building a mobile pixel art rpg game using Perplexity teammates. 

I have a game developer teammate who spins up Computer sessions and subagents for art, storytelling, game mechanics, etc. 

I lead on art direction, story arc, gameplay decisions and my teammate does the rest, building different parts in parallel, reviewing, and improving autonomously. 

It’s crazy that we can now create custom games around super niche personal interests. Like pirates and a knights templar legend.

So far, the game works on desktop and mobile browser, eventually plan to see if i can get it in the app store.
